== Description ==
The '''Crook''', formerly the '''Crook 1''', was a [[Units|unit]] that used to be spawned by the [[Crook Boss]] at Level 4. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. The '''Crook''' had a spawnrate of 60 seconds.

Whenever there was an enemy in its range, the '''Crook''' would stop moving to shoot at the enemies. It would continue walking when there were no enemies left in its range.

==Appearance==
{{Tabber
|Version 2
|The second version of the '''Crook''' had tan skin, black legs, dark grey shoes, white torso with black and yellow stripes, and white sleeves. It had a smile face. It wore a grey beanie. It carried an [[wp:Uzi|UZI]] in its right hand to shoot at enemies.
|Version 1
|The first version of the '''Crook''' had yellow skin, black legs, white torso with black and white stripes, white sleeves, and a mischievous face. It wore a black and white striped headband. It carried a Micro [[wp:Uzi|UZI]] to shoot at enemies.
}}

== Strategy ==
*You should not rely too much on '''Crooks''' because of their slow spawnrate.
*The '''Crook''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defenses, like the [[Giant Boss]].
**However, the '''Crook's''' ranged damage is still affected by enemies with defense.
*The '''Crook''' cannot detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies, but they can still be damaged when the '''Crook''' collides with them. However, this is likely unfavorable as the '''Crook's''' main source of damage is ranged.
**The '''Crook''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]].
*On two-pathed maps, only one '''Crook''' will spawn per Level 4 [[Crook Boss]]. It will go down a random path.
*The '''Crook''' will struggle against fast enemies like the [[Rusher (Polluted Wasteland)|Rusher]] or [[Glitch]], as they can run into '''Crooks''' without taking much damage.
*The '''Crook''' is not affected by any buffs given by other towers, like the [[Commander]], whether the '''Crook''' is in the range of a tower that grants a buff or if the [[Crook Boss]] is in the range of a tower that grants a buff.
*The '''Crook''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units, as their health is lower than any amount of damage that these enemies deal.
**For example, if the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] uses its ''Stomp'' attack, and a '''Crook''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed.

== Trivia ==
*The [[Crook Boss|{{Color|Golden}} Crook Boss]] used to spawn [[Golden Crook]]s instead of '''Crooks'''.
**All the other skins for the [[Crook Boss]], including the former {{Color|Platinum}} skin, used to spawn the regular '''Crook'''.
**Unlike the '''Crook''', the [[Golden Crook]] remained in the game until the 13th of May 2022.
*The '''Crook''' was based on the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/subcultures/mafia-city Mafia City meme].
*The first version of the '''Crook''' used same death sound that Roblox uses.
*The '''Crook''' could be seen on the original [[Crook Boss]] Level 4 upgrade icon.
*In the Frost Invasion Update, the '''Crook''' was replaced with the [[Body Guard]] and [[Body Guards 1]].
*The beanie used by the second version of the '''Crook''' is the {{RLinkC|1038669|Italian Ski Cap}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
